title: When the Salt Breaks
author: Oscar Pemberton
blurb: Ivo Ashgrove, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
